name: seed-adapter-tests
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp seed-test-inputs/dsl.ts core/dsl.ts; cp seed-test-inputs/proof-output.ts core/proof-output.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.candidate-seed.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-public.test.ts research/bapa/counted-seed.test.ts research/bapa/sum-seed.test.ts research/bapa/kind-seed.test.ts research/bapa/field-seed.test.ts research/bapa/multi-family-seed.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/counted-seed-symbolic.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/symbolic.log" 2>&1; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < seed-test-inputs/commit-message.txt > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; sha256sum core/dsl.ts core/proof-output.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/source-boundary.sha256"

name: seed-restatement-six
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp seed-test-inputs/dsl.ts core/dsl.ts; cp seed-test-inputs/proof-output.ts core/proof-output.ts; cp seed-audit-models/p1.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/seed-audit-p1-models.ts; cp seed-audit-models/p2.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/seed-audit-p2-models.ts; cp seed-audit-models/p4.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/seed-audit-p4-models.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/candidate-seed-audit.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.log" 2>&1
